---
name: git-branch
description: >
  Creates a correctly named git branch in one of the notifications-workspace repos
  (ds-notification-service, ds-message-template-api, ds-event-definitions, notification-definitions,
  integration-services). Use when asked to make/create/start a branch, "branch for ANW-1234",
  or before committing work that is still on develop/main.
---

## Naming standard

```
<type>/<JIRA-KEY>-<lowercase-kebab-slug>
```

Derived from the existing remote branches of all five repos (about 430 branches). No repo
documents a rule, so this is the dominant pattern, not a policy.

| Part | Rule | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `feature` (new work), `bugfix` (Jira Bug), `hotfix` (patch to a deployed release), `ops` (dependency/tooling/chore), `test` | `feature/` is the most common prefix for non-release work (107 branches; hotfix has 117 only because RIS has 90). `bugfix/` is used for ANW bugs (`bugfix/ANW-2570-sensor-offline-severity`). `fix/` appears only in notification-definitions (9 `fix/event-map-*`); use `bugfix/` instead. |
| `JIRA-KEY` | Uppercase, exactly as in Jira. Omit only if there is no ticket. | ANW (this team) is the key in `feature/ANW-2567-siren-subtype` and `bugfix/ANW-2526-critical-battery-severity`. Other keys seen: TABASCO, SRQCLOUD, PCS, RO, SMBV, RN, MW. |
| `slug` | 3 to 6 lowercase words, hyphen separated, no spaces, underscores or `&`. Keep the whole name under about 60 characters. | Keyed branches have both cases (33 slugs with uppercase, 25 all lowercase), but every recent template-api ANW bugfix is lowercase (`bugfix/ANW-2576-sensor-fault-resolve`). Long Jira-title slugs (`feature/PCS-6404-Delete-All-Data-&-Close-Account-Request-Is-Allowed-...`) are hard to type. |
| `copilot/` | Never create by hand; generated by Copilot agents. | 30 branches across the repos. |

Validation pattern (key-only names such as `feature/ANW-2685` are allowed):

```
^(feature|bugfix|hotfix|ops|test)/([A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+(-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*)?|[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*)$
```

### Same ticket across repos

Use the **identical branch name in every repo** that changes for the ticket. `feature/ANW-2567-siren-subtype`
exists in ds-notification-service, ds-message-template-api and integration-services. Counter-example to
avoid: ANW-2570 became `bugfix/ANW-2570-sensor-offline-severity` in template-api but
`ANW-2570-sensoroffline-severity-high` in notification-definitions.

## Base branch (check `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`)

| Repo | Base |
|---|---|
| ds-notification-service | `develop` |
| ds-message-template-api | `develop` |
| integration-services | `develop` |
| ds-event-definitions | `main` |
| notification-definitions | `main` |

## Exceptions by repo

### integration-services (RIS) differs

RIS has about 310 remote branches and several conventions the other repos do not use. Follow the standard
above for new feature and bugfix work, and do not copy these:

- **Numeric folders** (`232394/AutoAcceptProAlerts`, `274460/SMBV-7077_Partner_contact`; 52 branches). Personal
  or team-id folders from the Pro/SMB work. Do not create new ones.
- **Initials/name folders** (`om/PCS-6666-...`, `nico/poc/...`) and **bare names with no type** (83 branches,
  e.g. `ANW-2706`, `DeviceAlertSwapping`). Always add the type prefix.
- **Other keys** are common here: PCS (46), RO (25), SRQCLOUD (19), SMBV (6), ANW (7). Use whichever key the ticket has.
- `bugfix/` is rare in RIS (3), but it is the right type for a Jira Bug (`bugfix/ANW-2706`).
- **Hotfixes follow the release, not the ticket** (90 hotfix branches, versions are 1.x, not 0.1.x):
  - `hotfix/ris-release-<version>-next-hotfix-<n>` (about 40) and `-prod-hotfix-<n>` (9)
  - `hotfix/tag-<version>[-<n>]` (22)
  - `hotfix/<key>-<slug>` is rare (`hotfix/ro-<n>-accessible-ids-plan-fix`)

### Hotfixes in the other repos

ds-notification-service and ds-message-template-api mostly use `hotfix/<version>` (0.1.x, e.g.
`hotfix/0.1.874`, `hotfix/0.1.162`) and sometimes `hotfix/tag-<version>` or
`hotfix/<KEY>`. Hotfix branches are cut from the deployed release (tag or commit), not from the tip of `develop`.
**Ask the user for the release/tag and the target environment; never guess a version.**

### Definitions repos

notification-definitions also has bulk, generated-style names (`fix/event-map-<device-family>`) and
`copilot/` branches. Ignore both and use the standard.

## Steps

1. **Repo.** Work out which repo(s) the change is in (cwd, or `git status` in each affected repo). The workspace root is
   not where work branches are made; each sub-repo is its own git repo, so run git inside it.
2. **Ticket.** Take the key from the user's message. If there is a key, fetch it (Atlassian MCP `getJiraIssue`,
   cloudId `resideo.atlassian.net`) to get the issue type and summary. Bug maps to `bugfix`; Story/Task/Epic child to `feature`;
   chores to `ops`. If there is no key, ask whether one exists before using the no-key form.
3. **Slug.** Shorten the summary to 3 to 6 lowercase words (drop filler words; keep device or event names). Reuse the
   slug of an existing branch for the same ticket in another repo (`git branch -r --list '*<KEY>*'`).
4. **Name check.** Show the proposed name and test it against the validation pattern. Make sure it does not already exist:
   `git fetch origin --prune && git branch -a --list "*<name>*"`.
5. **Create.**
   - If the working tree is clean: `git switch -c <name> origin/<base>`.
   - If there are uncommitted changes (the usual case when a fix was already started on `develop`/`main`): run
     `git switch -c <name>` so the changes come with it, and warn the user if HEAD is behind `origin/<base>`.
   - Never discard or stash the user's changes without asking.
6. **Report** the branch name and repo. Do not push unless asked (`git push -u origin <name>`).

## Real examples to follow

| Situation | Branch |
|---|---|
| Bug, template severity | `bugfix/ANW-2570-sensor-offline-severity` (ds-message-template-api) |
| Bug, severity | `bugfix/ANW-2526-critical-battery-severity` (ds-message-template-api) |
| Feature across three repos | `feature/ANW-2567-siren-subtype` (ds-notification-service, ds-message-template-api, integration-services) |
| Feature, other key | `feature/TABASCO-16863-gulf-onboarding` (ds-notification-service) |
| Chore | `ops/dependency-update-2026-09-15` (ds-notification-service) |
| RIS hotfix | `hotfix/ris-release-1.51.4-next-hotfix-1` (integration-services) |
| NS hotfix | `hotfix/0.1.874` (ds-notification-service) |
